task: open-tennis-robots (flagship 10) buildable item: why a 0.8 s wheel braking to 526 rpm settles 3-4% low and takes ~2 s to creep back
errors: A summary-formatting bug in tests/ball_hold_drill.py crashed its report after a 45-minute run that kept no raw rows; the sweep now appends each drill to a .jsonl and resumes from it.
A container restart killed the second drill run near its end; the resumable .jsonl came from that loss.
A drill run was restarted after a firmware edit (the ball hold ending on a target change) landed mid-run, so its numbers would match what ships.

doc_friction.issue: The buildable item said the wheel was 'braking to 526 rpm' and settling low; the undershoot the item quoted was the recovery from the ball, with the brake a second, separate windup. Phrasing an open item as a cause sent the first hour at the ball only.

deviations.why: The drill-level check ran on a reduced grid (two plants, 0.4/0.8 s wheels, 24 drills) rather than every plant and lag, after two full runs were lost to a bug and a container restart.
deviations.did: Ran the one-ball, braking and spin-up sweeps on every plant, lag and free speed, and the drills on the reduced grid; the README says which were left out.
deviations.result: All 24 drills faster, none aborted; 0.2 s wheels and the jittery tach untested at drill level.

notes: Two causes, both integrator windup: (1) a ball's drop, seen 0.3 s late by the tach, charged the integrator to +0.022 (wheel to 625 rpm, then 3.6% low); (2) braking 3,895->526 rpm, the ramp outran the wheel and the integrator reached -0.164 vs a 0.058 feedforward (wheel coasted to ~90 rpm). Fixes in controller.WheelLoop: ball hold from stroke start until back on target (LOOP_BALL_BAND 0.005), integrator held while the ramp lowers a target (LOOP_RAMP_HOLD), bounded to 35% of feedforward (LOOP_I_FF_MAX). A global clamp was tried first and rejected (125/336 spin-ups never steady). Simulated: one ball mean 1.37->0.89 s, worst 4.96->2.43; braking mean 5.91->4.97, worst 10.97->7.85; slow-wheel spin-ups worst 11.62->7.63; 30-shot slow drill 140.8->134.9 s (first-order) and 143.6->135.9 s (ESC 30 ms), record drops unchanged. Costs: 0.2 s wheels told the wrong free speed dip more after a ball (7->17 of 72 over 2%); drill-pair spin-ups worst 5.12->5.29 s. Verification: run_venture_tests.py open-tennis-robots (351 tests ok on the first commit, 352 ok on the final), venture-preflight clean on the first commit.
